issue_title: [Feature] Add file lock mechanism for safe concurrent multi-process writes
implementation_summary: Added optional file locking mechanism to TodoStorage for safe concurrent multi-process writes. Implemented platform-specific locking (fcntl.flock on Unix, msvcrt.locking on Windows) with a _acquire_lock() context manager. The feature is opt-in via use_locking parameter for backward compatibility.
risks: Non-blocking lock on Windows (LK_NBLCK) could fail if lock is held - may need retry logic for high-contention scenarios
Lock file (.json.lock) persists after use - could accumulate if not cleaned up
Network filesystems may have different locking semantics
